description: Månedsrapporter - Trafikdata is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DSB. The monthly reports to the Ministry of Transport contain traffic data in the form of passenger income, number of journeys, occupancy, train-kilometres, arrivals, reasons for delays and cancellations, including allocation of responsibility, replacement bus services, customer punctuality, trainset-kilometres between technical incidents, equipment inoperative and point-kilometres. Data includes both S-trains and long-distance & regional trains. Coverage: DSB. The portal shows the English title as "Monthly reports - Traffic data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DSB. Its keywords include forsinkelser, mdbf, trafikdata, strækningsdata, litrakilometer, togkilometer. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
